## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the duplicated "Adopted" output before merge: `run` now prints each adoption message twice, which contradicts the description's claim that command output is unchanged apart from adoption progress.

## Changes
The PR makes `plan` return `adopt` entries for settings that already exist and add a trailing `audit` entry that counts the incoming settings. It also adds two tests for the audit entry and a new `app/review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop `run` from emitting adoption messages twice — When `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` is called, it now emits "Adopted theme" twice. `plan` already emits that message as progress at `app/planner.py:8`, and `app/cli.py:6-9` emits every change that is not `audit`, which now includes the new `adopt` entry. No test calls `run` with an existing setting, because `test_adoption_progress` calls only `plan`. — Every adopted setting appears twice in command output, and no test guards against this. — Fix: Either skip `adopt` in the loop at `app/cli.py:7` as it already skips `audit`, or stop emitting at `app/planner.py:8`, then add a `run`-level adoption test next to `test_adoption_progress`.
